exposure: Maternal viral infection (anelloviruses: TTV, TTMDV, TTMV)
cohort: The study participants were women experiencing either spontaneous labor or PROM, categorized as cases if occurring before 37 weeks' gestation (preterm) or controls if occurring at term.
finding: The presence of anelloviruses in maternal serum was significantly associated with a higher likelihood of experiencing preterm labor or PROM compared to term labor.
gest_age: Cases were women with labor or PROM < 37 weeks' gestation; controls were women with labor or PROM at term.
